gate.season_fails_class_if: any rule of the class breaks

rules.label: Humid hours
rules.fails_when: the 7-day mean of daily hours above 90% RH exceeds 7 hours a day

sources.text: Yunis, H., Shtienberg, D., Elad, Y. and Mahrer, Y. (1994). Qualitative approach for modelling outbreaks of grey mould epidemics in non-heated cucumber greenhouses. Crop Protection 13(2):99-104.
Sentelhas, P.C. et al. (2008). Suitability of relative humidity as an estimator of leaf wetness duration. Agricultural and Forest Meteorology 148:392-400.

rules.label: Longest humid run
rules.fails_when: RH stays above 93% for more than 48 hours in a row

sources.text: Körner, O. (2003). Crop based climate regimes for energy saving in greenhouse cultivation. PhD thesis, Wageningen University.

rules.label: 6-day mean
rules.harm: chronic heat or cold; growth and development
rules.fails_when: the 6-day mean air temperature is more than 4 C from the 6-day mean target, where each day's target is 17.5 C plus 1.5 C per 1000 J/cm2 of that day's outdoor radiation

sources.text: Körner, O. and Challa, H. (2003). Design for an improved temperature integration concept in greenhouse cultivation. Computers and Electronics in Agriculture 39(1):39-59.
de Gelder, A., Warmenhoven, M. and Grootscholten, M. (2010). Het Nieuwe Telen Tomaat 2010. Wageningen UR Glastuinbouw, GTB-1178.
Adams, S.R., Cockshull, K.E. and Cave, C.R.J. (2001). Effect of temperature on the growth and development of tomato fruits. Annals of Botany 88:869-877.

rules.label: Dose of extremes
rules.fails_when: the dose in any 24 hours exceeds 1. Time below 14 C or above 30 C adds to it with Körner and Challa's exponential weight (exponents 160 and 30), 0 at 14 or 30 C and 1 at 10 or 34 C; 30 minutes at 10 or 34 C is a full dose

sources.text: Körner, O. and Challa, H. (2003). Design for an improved temperature integration concept in greenhouse cultivation. Computers and Electronics in Agriculture 39(1):39-59.

rules.label: Absolute limits
rules.fails_when: the air temperature stays below 10 C or above 34 C for 30 minutes or more in a row
